name: total-fitness-studio
description: Total Fitness Studio (Chromepet, Chennai) - High-performance gym website with 4.9★ rating

scripts.build:css: cat css/style.css css/animations.css > css/bundle.css && bun build css/bundle.css --outfile=css/bundle.min.css --minify && rm -f css/bundle.css
scripts.build:js: cat js/calculator.js js/schedule.js js/modal.js js/app.js > js/bundle.js && bun build js/bundle.js --outfile=js/bundle.min.js --minify && rm -f js/bundle.js
scripts.build: bun run build:css && bun run build:js
